turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided on the zero, and when?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
I'm not here for what Owen says in class. The zero: whose decision, and was he heard first?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then why is there a zero next to his name? You've dodged twice now; what's the evidence?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
No, we can't. That's a leading question, and you've just told me my son cheated without showing me a single thing.
